563: (defn- begin-implicit
564:   "Open an implicit transaction — one pgwire started itself (no client BEGIN), so pgwire will auto-commit it.
565:   [access-mode] is :read-only / :read-write / nil (bare — the connection takes its session default access mode).
566:   The connection pins the read basis (awaiting this connection's own writes) at the transaction's first query."
567:   [{:keys [conn-state]} access-mode]
568:   (let [^Xtdb$Connection node-conn (:node-conn @conn-state)]
569:     (case access-mode
570:       :read-only (.beginReadOnly node-conn)
571:       :read-write (.beginWriteOnly node-conn nil nil false)
572:       (.begin node-conn))

584:   ([{:keys [conn-state tx-latency-timer] :as conn} commit-mode]
585:    ;; the connection owns the buffered ops + tx options; it submits (async) or submits-and-awaits (sync), clears
586:    ;; its transaction, and records lastSubmittedTx. A commit-time COMMIT SYNC / COMMIT ASYNC wins; a bare COMMIT
587:    ;; (nil mode) defers to the tx's begin-time async flag. The sync commit yields the awaited ExecutedTx, whose
588:    ;; error pgwire re-throws so the client sees it. Counting `tx.error` is the connection's job — it sees both the
589:    ;; presubmit failures and the aborted txs re-thrown here.
590:    (let [^Xtdb$Connection node-conn (:node-conn @conn-state)]
591:      (if (.isTxFailed node-conn)
592:        (throw (pgio/err-protocol-violation "transaction failed"))
593: 
594:        (try
595:          (let [async? (if (nil? commit-mode)
596:                         (.isTxAsync node-conn)
597:                         (= commit-mode ParsedStatement$CommitMode/ASYNC))]
598:            (metrics/record-callable! tx-latency-timer
599:                                      (if async?
600:                                        (with-auth-check conn (.commitAsync node-conn))
601:                                        (when-let [^Xtdb$ExecutedTx executed (with-auth-check conn (.commitSync node-conn))]
602:                                          (when-let [error (.getError executed)]
603:                                            (throw error))))))
604:          (finally
605:            (end-transaction conn)))))))

29: export const metadataInputs = (
30:   txId: TransactionId,
31:   position: number,
32:   instant: number,
33:   meta: TransactionMeta | undefined,
34:   changes: readonly TransactionChange[],
35: ): readonly TripleInput[] => {
36:   const input = (attribute: string, value: TripleInput["value"]): TripleInput => ({
37:     entityId: txId,
38:     attribute,
39:     value,
40:     entityType: "_Transaction",
41:   });
42:   return [
43:     input(TxAttributes.POSITION, { type: "number", value: position }),
44:     input(TxAttributes.INSTANT, { type: "datetime", value: instant }),
45:     ...(meta?.actor ? [input(TxAttributes.ACTOR, text(meta.actor))] : []),
46:     ...(meta?.commandId ? [input(TxAttributes.COMMAND_ID, text(meta.commandId))] : []),
47:     ...(meta?.correlationId ? [input(TxAttributes.CORRELATION_ID, text(meta.correlationId))] : []),
48:     ...(meta?.causationId ? [input(TxAttributes.CAUSATION_ID, text(meta.causationId))] : []),
49:     ...(meta?.configSnapshot
50:       ? [input(TxAttributes.CONFIG_SNAPSHOT, text(meta.configSnapshot))]
51:       : []),
52:     ...[...new Set(changes.map((change) => change.entityId))].map((entityId) =>
53:       input(TxAttributes.CHANGED_ENTITY, { type: "ref", value: entityId }),
54:     ),
55:     ...changes.map((change) => input(TxAttributes.CHANGE, { type: "json", value: change })),
56:   ];
57: };
